title: Ordering Lunch at the Sunny Café
instructions: 阅读短文，完成8道题。题目和选项均为英文。注意：本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。请先读短文，再做题。答案必须来自短文。
passage:
A. It is 12:30. Li Wei and his sister Li Na are at the Sunny Café. They are hungry. A waiter comes to their table. "Can I help you?" he asks.

B. Li Wei says, "I want a chicken sandwich, please. I cannot eat cheese. I do not like it." Li Na says, "I want a tomato salad. I like vegetables. But I do not like onions." The waiter says, "The salad has no onions. It has tomatoes and eggs." Li Na says, "Good. I can eat eggs."

C. The waiter asks, "Do you want drinks?" Li Wei says, "Yes, I want water." Li Na says, "I want orange juice, please." The waiter says, "OK. One sandwich, one salad, one water, and one juice."

questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“It is 12:30.”，所以时间是12:30。

questions.explanation: Li Wei说“I want a chicken sandwich, please.”，所以他要鸡肉三明治。

grammar.title: 第三人称单数；do / does 问答；like；can / cannot；and / but
grammar.explanation: 在一般现在时中，当主语是 he、she、it 或一个人名（第三人称单数）时，动词要加 -s 或 -es。例如：He wants water. She likes salad. 否定用 does not + 动词原形，例如：He does not like cheese. 疑问用 Do/Does 开头：Do you want drinks? Does she like onions? 回答用 Yes, I do. / No, I do not. 或 Yes, she does. / No, she does not. like 表示喜好：I like vegetables. can 表示能力或允许：I can eat eggs. cannot 表示不能：I cannot eat cheese. and 连接两个相同或并列的内容：tomatoes and eggs. but 表示转折：I like vegetables, but I do not like onions.
grammar.example: Li Wei says, "I want a chicken sandwich, please. I cannot eat cheese. I do not like it."

questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，动词 like 要加 -s，变成 likes。所以选“She likes apples.”
主语 he 是第三人称单数，疑问句用 Does 开头，后面动词用原形 want。所以选“Does he want tea?”
主语 he 是第三人称单数，否定用 does not + 动词原形 like。所以选“He does not like fish.”

questions.prompt: Choose the correct answer to: "Do you want water?"
questions.explanation: Do you...? 的肯定回答是 Yes, I do. 所以选“Yes, I do.”

questions.prompt: Choose the correct answer to: "Does she like salad?"
questions.explanation: Does she...? 的肯定回答是 Yes, she does. 所以选“Yes, she does.”

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with can.
questions.explanation: can 后面用动词原形 eat，不用 eats 或 eating。所以选“I can eat eggs.”

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with cannot.
questions.explanation: cannot 后面用动词原形 eat。所以选“He cannot eat cheese.”

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with but.
options: I like tea, but I do not like coffee.
I like tea, and I do not like coffee.
I like tea, but I not like coffee.
answers: I like tea, but I do not like coffee.
questions.explanation: but 表示转折，后面接完整的否定句“I do not like coffee.”。所以选“I like tea, but I do not like coffee.”
questions.evidence: I like tea, but I do not like coffee.
